title: The heaviest armor you wear isn’t protecting you from the enemy; it’s protecting you from the Healer. 🛡️🩹
paragraphs: The heaviest armor you wear isn’t protecting you from the enemy; it’s protecting you from the Healer. 🛡️🩹

We often think pride is strength, but in the Kingdom, it’s our greatest weakness. It’s the wall we build that keeps pain locked in and God locked out. True strength isn't pretending you aren't wounded; it's having the courage to show God where it hurts so He can finally make it whole.
Drop the shield. Surrender the struggle. Let the healing begin.
📖 "He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds." — Psalm 147:3
🔥 Are you ready to lay down your pride?
